title: close --summary credits a research sprint's goal clauses to its goal research story

clauses.clause: close --summary credits a goal clause to the goal research story whose narrowed goal or whose touches in the public root carry it when no other item does, instead of unmet (the SP-4phd36pa close printed every clause unmet though ST-bivdc2fa answered all of them)

a clause names every done item that carries it with the story before a bug filed from it, so a bug that mirrors the clause never stands alone as its carrier (SP-x5gjv4r7: BG-bgnkzjzt named for ST-ylje2dxh's clause)

move's clauses_left_behind and close --summary's goal_clause_lines read one carrier filter: a review story never carries a clause and a goal research story is a fallback carrier for close --summary only

gates.question: How does close --summary name the carrier of a goal clause when several done items hold at least half its words?
options: every done item over CLAUSE_COVER, the story before a bug, highest share first
the one done item with the highest share, a story preferred to a bug filed from it
gates.recommendation: every done item over CLAUSE_COVER, the story before a bug, highest share first
gates.answer: every done item over CLAUSE_COVER, the story before a bug, highest share first

gates.question: Does a goal research story carry a goal clause in move's clauses_left_behind and in close --summary's goal_clause_lines?
options: fallback: close --summary credits it for a clause no implementing item carries; move never counts it
full carrier: both count it as an item of the sprint
gates.recommendation: fallback: close --summary credits it for a clause no implementing item carries; move never counts it
gates.answer: fallback: close --summary credits it for a clause no implementing item carries; move never counts it

gates.question: How is a sprint goal clause credited to an item whose clauses mapping states it in other words?
options: the same word cover, with a plural or verb s folded, over the item's title, goal and mapped clauses
a recorded link: the planner writes the sprint clause on the item and close reads that field
gates.recommendation: the same word cover, with a plural or verb s folded, over the item's title, goal and mapped clauses
gates.answer: the same word cover, with a plural or verb s folded, over the item's title, goal and mapped clauses

gates.question: Which touches does a goal research story's fallback read for the words of a clause: those inside any named kb root, or only kb/public?
options: any named kb root (research_touches: kb/<root>/..., never kb/_self), the path after the root's name
gates.recommendation: any named kb root (research_touches: kb/<root>/..., never kb/_self), the path after the root's name
gates.answer: any named kb root (research_touches: kb/<root>/..., never kb/_self), the path after the root's name

gates.question: Where is the plural or verb s folded: in every clause word match (carry, left-behind and the similar open item hint), or only where an item carries a clause?
options: every match: clause_words folds, so carry, left-behind and the similar hint read one word set
carry matches only: the similar hint keeps unfolded words
gates.recommendation: every match: clause_words folds, so carry, left-behind and the similar hint read one word set
gates.answer: every match: clause_words folds, so carry, left-behind and the similar hint read one word set

notes:
Filed as a retrospective draft at the SP-4phd36pa close. Merged at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: BG-dpsfmyqi (a bug filed from a story named as the clause's carrier; its repro read eb70b55938), BG-jrfac5wz (clauses_left_behind counts review and goal research stories as carriers where goal_clause_lines does not), ST-vbdyapo3 (SP-qjg5r7jj: 'rag.py eval keeps every row' printed unmet though the item's clauses mapping states it). The failure recurred at the closes of SP-ajcomz6d, SP-qjn563cf, SP-up5wchen (2026-10-11) and SP-j2jn5ue4 (2026-10-12): every clause printed unmet, with unrelated similar-item hints, though the goal research story answered each. Gates answered at planning: carriers, research-carrier, mapping-credit.
Premise: the four checks run on a planted sprint at planning (2026-10-12, main a5a7459f2): close --summary printed 'unmet' for the research story's clause, named BG-b alone for the mirrored clause and 'unmet' for the mapped clause, and clauses_left_behind returned [] with a research story present: premise reproduces.
Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 19 of 19, "Close credits each goal clause to its carrier, and a research story's check reads its questions' coverage"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
